verdict.rationale: Capacities' documentation and probes show it acts as the MCP *server* side (other apps/agents build MCP clients to talk to Capacities, and AI chat apps like ChatGPT/Claude/Cursor connect via 'Chat Connectors'), not as a client that plugs in external MCP servers to gain their tools. There is no evidence Capacities itself can consume third-party MCP servers' tools.
